name: TF3 Companion Bridge
summary: Read-only company data export for the TF3 Companion analyst. Changes nothing in your game.
description:
Turn your Transport Fever 3 company into something an AI analyst can read.

TF3 Companion Bridge periodically saves a read-only snapshot of your company: finances, lines, vehicles, stations, industries and towns. The free, local TF3 Companion app reads those snapshots and lets an AI assistant of your choice find losing lines, unserved industries, full stocks and expansion opportunities. You decide and make every change in the game yourself.

What it does
- Writes a snapshot file to your userdata folder (towns_industries/tf3c_snap_*.lua).
- Answers refresh requests from the Companion app.

What it does not do
- It never changes the simulation, your money, your vehicles or your save.
- It sends nothing over the network. Everything stays on your machine.

Requires the TF3 Companion app to analyse the snapshots. Without it the mod only writes snapshot files.

Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Urban Games or Paradox Interactive. Transport Fever is their trademark.
